pinterest.title: Santorini Wedding Venues on the Caldera: Greece Wedding Venues for 15 to 60 Guests
pinterest.description: Santorini's caldera terraces suit a smaller guest list. At Grace Hotel in Imerovigli, the 363 Lounge seats 40 and The Villa seats 15. Canaves in Oia offers the Veranda rooftop for up to 40 with 180-degree caldera views, and Katikies seats 60 at Botrini's Restaurant. For more than 100 guests, the Canaves Epitome gardens take 250 for a banquet. Compare 20 Greece wedding venues by region.

pinterest.title: Athens Riviera Wedding Venues: Greece Wedding Venues for Large Guest Lists
pinterest.description: For a guest list flying in from abroad, the Athens Riviera keeps transfers short. Grand Resort Lagonissi is about 20 minutes from Athens International Airport, with 16 private beaches. Four Seasons Astir Palace hosts events from 10 to 1,000 guests, and One&Only Aesthesis in Glyfada has a traditional white Greek chapel. Kokotos Estate, a family winery in Stamata, seats 500 in its open-air space.

pinterest.title: Greece Wedding Venues With Exclusive Use: Where You Can Take the Whole Hotel
pinterest.description: Exclusive use usually means a chosen event space, not the whole hotel. A few Greece wedding venues offer the whole property. Canaves in Oia sells full-property buyouts, from Canaves Sunday (10 rooms, up to 22 guests) to Canaves Epitome (53 rooms, up to 170). Katikies offers a hotel takeover, and Melenos Lindos on Rhodes suggests reserving the whole hotel for at least three nights. Ask every venue which one is being quoted.

slides: Santorini and the Cyclades: caldera terraces in Oia and Imerovigli seat 15 to 60. For more than 100 guests, the Canaves Epitome gardens take 250 for a banquet.
Crete: both venues in our guide have a private chapel in the grounds. Elounda Beach seats 430 outdoors at Artemis, and its wedding package covers the legal paperwork.
Rhodes, Kos and the Dodecanese: all three venues help with a civil ceremony. At Melenos Lindos, beside the acropolis, the hotel suggests taking the whole property for at least three nights.
Corfu and the Ionian: the green side of Greece. Corfu Imperial offers the private islet Nissaki for up to 50, and Angsana Corfu hosts 200 for a reception with 196 rooms on site.
Athens and the Athens Riviera: the largest guest lists and the shortest transfers. Four Seasons Astir Palace hosts 10 to 1,000 guests, about 30 minutes from central Athens.
The Peloponnese: resort country a drive from Athens. Costa Navarino has two chapels and four resorts in one destination; Amanzoe is a 2.5-hour drive from the airport.
Halkidiki: beach resorts on a northern peninsula. Sani Resort holds ceremonies in a stone church courtyard or on Ammos Beach, and Miraggio has both a beach and a ballroom.

instagram_carousel.caption:
Which Greece wedding venues suit your guest list?

The right region depends less on the view than on three questions: how many guests you are inviting, which kind of ceremony you want, and how those guests will travel. A caldera terrace in Oia suits 40 people. A Riviera resort half an hour from central Athens hosts up to 1,000.

Our new guide sets out 20 venues across seven regions, from Santorini and Crete to Corfu, the Peloponnese and Halkidiki, with the same details for every one: ceremony on site, largest published capacity, rooms, exclusive use and how guests get there.

The short version: let guest count choose the region, ask each venue whether exclusive use means a chosen space or the whole hotel, and get the curfew, minimum nights and rain plan in writing before you pay a deposit.

Shortlisting Greek venues for your own wedding? Send us a message with your date, guest count and the venues you have in mind, and a Wedded Advisor will help you compare them. Full guide at the link in our bio.
